name: DUMBBELL TOE-TOUCH CRUNCH LEFT
introduce:
Lie on your back with your left arm raised up and hold a dumbbell in your left hand. 

Put your right arm on the ground at your side. Bend your left leg and keep your right leg straight on the ground. 

Raise your shoulders and right leg up to make your right foot touch the dumbbell. Then lower them back and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a dumbbell and a mat.
Please squeeze your core as hard as you can when you raise up.
Please keep the lifted leg straight.
Please make sure your upper back leaves the ground when you raise up.
It works on your rectus abdominus, obilques and shoulders.
